keyA.notes: p161 has marker 161+ because p160 ends mid-sentence inside prayer (١٧). Its two footnotes are new (١)/(٢), and no footnote carries over from p160. On p161 the يا الله / يا مجيب are black, not red: the page has no red pixels. p162 is the day-opening page: أعوذ, the basmala and the two Quran quotations (الأعراف ١٨٠ with no ayah number, الأحزاب ٥٦ with one), then two paragraphs with flower-asterisk bullets written as *. p163 starts a new prayer (٨٦), so it has a plain marker. p163 ends mid-sentence, so p164 has the + marker. p164 ends mid-sentence in prayer ٩٠. Red divine Names marked ==…==: مُقْسِطُ، جَامِعَ (first one only; the second جَامِعَ is black), غَنِيُّ، مُغْنِي، مُعْطِي (مَانِعُ is black). The red spots were confirmed by a pixel-colour check. Quran آل عمران ١٨ is printed without an ayah-number ornament, so none was added. It is encoded per Tanzil: قَآئِمًۢا with iqlab mim, waqf ۚ after بِٱلْقِسْطِ. لتهدىٓ (الشورى ٥٢) is written with dotless ى as printed. In several places the print has no space after the comma (e.g. قِيَامٍ،صَلَاةً، الْوُجُودِ،وَبَيْنَ، بِكَ،صَلَاةً). A single space was added after the comma, per the one-space rule. الله with a printed case vowel is written اللَّهُ/اللَّهَ/اللَّهِ. لله, printed without harakat, is kept as لله. التَّنْعِيم in the p161 footnotes has a sukun above the shadda-fatha of ت, read as the sukun of ن. Harakat were checked at 1100-2600 dpi zooms.

uncertain.why: Besides the shadda+fatha on ب and the tanween only one plain fatha is printed over the مح ligature; by its position it seems to sit on ح, not م (compare p.164 where the same word has two fathas).

keyB.notes: p161 continues the sentence of p160 (marker +); no footnote continues. p164 continues the sentence ending p163 ('وَأَنْ تَجْمَعَنِي عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا' / 'مُحَمَّدٍ'), marker +. Red divine names: مُقْسِطُ, جَامِعَ (p163), غَنِيُّ, مُغْنِي, مُعْطِي (p164); وَيَا مَانِعُ and وَيَا جَامِعَ النَّاسِ are printed black. Partial vowelling kept as printed, e.g. p163 'وَالْموْتِ' (no fatha on م, sukun on ل and و), p164 'وجَعَلْتَهُ' (no fatha on و), p161 'المُتَخَلِّقِ' (no sukun on lam), p162 'وَبارِكْ بِأَسْمائِكَ' in the first prayer but 'بِأَسْمَائِكَ' at its end; آلِه vs آلِهِ distinguished per occurrence. Missing spaces after commas in print (e.g. 'قِيَامٍ،صَلَاةً') normalized to one space. اللهُ/اللهِ/اللهَ with printed case vowel written اللَّه…; bare لله kept.
